name: push-up (on stability ball)
description: A push-up with the feet on a stability ball. The moving support challenges core control while the chest and arms press the body up.
instructions: Place your feet or lower legs on a stability ball and set your hands on the floor beneath your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor without letting the ball roll away.
Press back up to straight arms while keeping your hips steady.
